note: Text-free: ids, setting keys, package ids, screen ids, doc sections. Generated by evals/build_locomo_solution_map.py; hypotheses, not measurements.

gold_error.label: Gold or dataset error (errata)
gold_error.rule: (item, qid) carries a default-excluded errata tag: gold_error, needs_image or premise_error
gold_error.no_solution_needed: dataset error: the errata file reports accuracy with and without it (SOL-ERRATA); not an engine fault

judge_false_negative.label: Judge false negative (answer states the gold fact)
judge_false_negative.rule: wrong verdict but judge conventions credit it (list_superset, typo) or every content word of the gold sits in the answer (answer_contains_gold)

relative_date_gold_vs_judge.label: Relative-date or range gold against an absolute-date answer (judge/format)
relative_date_gold_vs_judge.rule: wrong verdict, date question, and the answer date overlaps the gold interval at another granularity, or the date guard says equivalent, or the gold is a relative phrase ('the week before D', 'N years ago') that the answer resolves

write_path_loss.label: Gold turn not stored or altered at write
write_path_loss.no_solution_needed: 0 cases in clean-jina-full (FULL_RUN_FORENSICS s2.3(a): the write path is clean)

open_domain_inference_retrieval.label: Open-domain: evidence is an implication, recall/cut
open_domain_inference_retrieval.rule: category open-domain and stage in b/cf/cr

temporal_evidence_missing.label: Temporal: date-dependent gold turn not retrieved
temporal_evidence_missing.rule: category temporal and stage in b/cf/cr

rerank_keep_cut.label: Gold in the reranker pool, cut by rerank_keep
rerank_keep_cut.rule: stage cr (gold in the reranker pool, not in the final list)

list_aggregation_generic.label: List / aggregation question with a generic category (category-to-instance gap)
list_aggregation_generic.rule: stage b/cf, >= 2 gold turns, and the question is list/aggregation shaped (what/which/who + plural set noun, 'what kind of', 'how many', or a comma/and-list gold)

implicit_or_paraphrased_gold.label: Answer not literally in the gold turn (implicit, paraphrased, noisy label)
implicit_or_paraphrased_gold.rule: stage b/cf, non-temporal non-open, and no content word of the gold answer occurs in any gold turn or its caption

fusion_loss_vector_only.label: Fusion loss: gold found by the vector leg only
fusion_loss_vector_only.doc: RECALL_GAPS_FORENSIC s2.5, s3 (195 of 237 fusion-lost turns vector-only); FULL_RUN_FORENSICS s2.3(c)
fusion_loss_vector_only.rule: stage cf and every lost gold turn is ranked in the vector leg only (no lexical, no extra leg)

fusion_loss_lexical_only.label: Fusion loss: gold found by BM25 / an extra leg only
fusion_loss_lexical_only.doc: RECALL_GAPS_FORENSIC s3; FULL_RUN_FORENSICS s3.3 (perspective leg crowds BM25-only gold)
fusion_loss_lexical_only.rule: stage cf and every lost gold turn is ranked in the lexical or an extra leg and not in the vector leg

fusion_loss_two_leg_crowded.label: Fusion loss: gold in both legs but outranked at the fused pool
fusion_loss_two_leg_crowded.rule: stage cf, a lost gold turn sits in the vector and the lexical leg

multi_evidence_recall.label: Recall: many gold turns across sessions, at least one in no leg
multi_evidence_recall.doc: RECALL_GAPS_FORENSIC s2.2 tags (4+ gold turns lift 2.24); s4
multi_evidence_recall.rule: stage b and >= 3 gold turns (or gold spans >= 3 sessions)

vocabulary_mismatch_recall.label: Recall: no stemmed content-word overlap between question and gold turn
vocabulary_mismatch_recall.rule: stage b and the lost gold turn shares no stemmed content word with the question

lexical_outranked_recall.label: Recall/cut: overlap exists but the turn is outranked (BM25 noise, morphology)

date_duration_arithmetic.label: Reader: duration / elapsed-time / two-event arithmetic
date_duration_arithmetic.doc: READER_GAPS_FORENSIC DARITH; FULL_RUN_FORENSICS s4.1; GAP_REGISTER I76
date_duration_arithmetic.rule: reader stage and the question asks how long / how many days|weeks|months|years (or bucket date_arithmetic)

date_offset_small.label: Reader: right event, date off by 1 to 7 days (weekday / 'last week' arithmetic)
date_offset_small.rule: reader stage, bucket wrong_absolute_date with a gap of at most 7 days

date_wrong_event.label: Reader: date of a different event, or a day invented in a coarse range
date_wrong_event.doc: FULL_RUN_FORENSICS s4.1 (wrong event matched, session date as event date); READER_GAPS_FORENSIC DIST
date_wrong_event.rule: reader stage, bucket wrong_absolute_date with a gap above 7 days, or no date in the answer

refusal_premise_denial.label: Reader: refusal or premise denial despite evidence in context

inference_open_domain.label: Reader: open-domain inference or world-knowledge step

list_incomplete.label: Reader: incomplete or over-inclusive list
list_incomplete.rule: reader stage and bucket list_missing_item / list_extra_item

count_wrong.label: Reader: wrong count
count_wrong.rule: reader stage and the question starts 'how many' (not a time-unit duration)

image_caption_misuse.label: Reader: answer sits in an image caption the reader ignored or mixed
image_caption_misuse.rule: reader stage and the gold answer tokens occur only inside '[image: ...]' captions of the gold turns

speaker_confusion.label: Reader: answer taken from the other speaker's turn
speaker_confusion.rule: reader stage, the question names exactly one of the two speakers and the answer names only the other one

distractor_line.label: Reader: answer follows a non-gold line in the context
distractor_line.rule: reader stage and >= 60% of the answer content words occur in a non-gold context line and in no gold turn

wrong_detail.label: Reader: right line, wrong or vague detail

no_gold_resolvable.label: No gold turn resolvable (malformed evidence id)
no_gold_resolvable.rule: wrong, no usable gold turn, no primary gap
no_gold_resolvable.no_solution_needed: malformed evidence id (locomo_errata bad_evidence_id): a dataset fix, not an engine one
